summary: Enforce native transcript visibility across content, tool invocations, orphan and joined results; render unsupported records with redacted capped Inspect previews and typed harness events as quiet rows with failed-job styling.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Native conversation blocks and typed views are authoritative when present; block-less fallback records remain supported. Internal and harness-hidden payloads cannot become readable transcript rows or visible tool results. Result-before-call delivery remains correct when call visibility changes, including same-frame call/result revisions. No storage schema or replay change.
